schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    UNIT_PRICE INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (UNIT_PRICE > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE SALES (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    SELLER_ID INT,
    BUYER_ID INT,
    SALE_DATE DATE,
    QUANTITY INT,
    PRICE INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (PRODUCT_ID) REFERENCES PRODUCT(PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0),
    CHECK (PRICE > 0)
);
q1: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2: SELECT DISTINCT S.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM SALES S LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND S.PRODUCT_ID NOT IN (SELECT S.PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES S LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SALE_DATE < '2019-01-01' OR SALE_DATE > '2019-03-31')
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT S.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM SALES S LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND S.PRODUCT_ID NOT IN (SELECT S.PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES S LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SALE_DATE < '2019-01-01' OR SALE_DATE > '2019-03-31')
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent. Q1 selects products whose all sales occurred between '2019-01-01' and '2019-03-31'. Q2 attempts to achieve the same but uses a different logic involving NOT IN with dates outside the range. However, Q2 may include products that have sales only within the range but also have NULLs in SALES (not applicable here) or fails to properly exclude all sales outside the range. A counterexample shows this difference.
counterexample_dsp: A product has one sale on '2019-02-15' (within range) and another sale on '2018-12-01' (outside range). Q1 excludes the product because of the sale outside the range. Q2 incorrectly includes the product due to flawed NOT IN logic.
